changes.title: E-stop re-made faithfully, on a stiffer bent L-bracket
changes.summary: The OMRON A22E-M-02 model is re-made from its data sheet with the switch block behind the panel (it passed through the bracket before, hidden by an allowed overlap, now removed). The flat plate is replaced by a bent 5052 L round the front-left post's corner, screwed into two slots (front and right side).

changes.title: Z motors: M3 mounting threads drawn
changes.summary: The four M3 x 4.5 threads on the 31 mm square (drawing A4003) are cut into each Z motor's solid; nothing else changes.

changes.title: Z nuts bolted direct to the plate
changes.summary: Each POM nut's flange is bolted to its nut plate with two M3 through-bolts in its own outer holes (the shop cannot tap M4 in 3/8 in plate; nuts on the inner holes would sit under the square). The floating keeper, spacers, keeper bolts and the anti-rotation pin are removed; each motor plate is lined up with its fixed nut at assembly and the screw, free at its top, takes the rest.
